e.title: VA Heatmap Simulation Machine (Wüthrich)
e.summary: 车速-加速度（v-a）热力图合成模拟器 R 代码：基于真实 GPS 驾驶数据校准的神经网络
e.body:
v-a-heatmap-simulation-machine 是 Wüthrich 提供的 R 代码：合成模拟个体车主的车速-加速度（velocity-acceleration）热力图（速度区间 (5,20] km/h）——模拟器基于校准自真实 GPS 驾驶数据的神经网络架构，用于车联网（telematics）驾驶行为建模（UBI 定价、风险评分）。对 RIAA：车联网数据合成与驾驶风险建模的前沿工具。与 [[zenroad-telematics]]（telematics）、[[mongodb-ubi-underwriting]]（UBI）、[[claim-frequency]]（车险定价）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。

## 同类工具
[[vinereg]]、[[volrisk]]、[[wh-revisit]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_en: R code to simulate synthetic velocity-acceleration (v-a) heatmaps of individual drivers: NN architecture calibrated on real GPS driving data
e.summary_hk: 車速-加速度（v-a）熱力圖合成模擬器 R 代碼：基於真實 GPS 駕駛數據校準的神經網絡
e.body_en:
v-a-heatmap-simulation-machine is R code by Wüthrich to simulate synthetic velocity-acceleration (v-a) heatmaps of individual car drivers (speed bucket (5,20] km/h): the simulator is based on a neural-network architecture calibrated on real GPS driving data — for telematics driving-behaviour modelling (UBI pricing, risk scoring). For RIAA: a frontier tool for telematics data synthesis and driving-risk modelling. Complements [[zenroad-telematics]] (telematics), [[mongodb-ubi-underwriting]] (UBI) and [[claim-frequency]] (motor pricing). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[machine-learning-pricing]].

## Similar tools
[[vinereg]]、[[volrisk]]、[[wh-revisit]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
